Emily Tran: Heads-up — I opened a tiny docs PR to add a migration snippet for tenant-affinity when teams move from reserved pools -> Dedicated. It bundles: a short YAML example for autoscale cooldown, a Python SDK example for scale_policy, and a note about SLA wording. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4321 Please skim the SLA phrasing and the isolation labels. cc @Raj Patel @Sam Kim

Raj Patel: Quick skim — looks good. One suggestion: don't say 'best-effort' in the mainline doc, it reads like we disclaim responsibility. Maybe use 'no SLA (best-effort performance)' where needed. Also add a one-liner about eviction/preemption windows.

Sam Kim: YAML example nit: we should include explicit tenant label example so customers see how to opt into tenant isolation. e.g. add `tenant_label: "team-x"` under allocation.

Claire Jones: Also there's a dead anchor in the FAQ link — the handbook anchor changed last month. Replace `#reserved-vs-dedicated` with `#capacity-modes` in the PR. I can push that change if you want.

Marc Brown: Small SDK snippet for the PR — feel free to copy this into the examples section under "Programmatic provisioning":

```python
from redwood import DedicatedClient
client = DedicatedClient(api_key="${REDWOOD_API_KEY}")
resp = client.create_capacity(
    name="team-x-dedicated",
    region="us-west-2",
    scale_policy={
        "min_replicas": 2,
        "max_replicas": 6,
        "cooldown_seconds": 300,
        "policy": "throughput_based"
    },
    labels={"tenant_label": "team-x", "isolation": "tenant"}
)
print(resp)
```

Marc Brown: Note: the runtime will still preempt for infra maintenance; put a short sentence under "SLA and evictions" to surface that.

Liz Yang: Cool. Tiny numbers nit: the cooldown_seconds in the YAML currently is 60 — that leads to flapping in our sims. Recommend 300 by default for dedicated autoscale. Also add a short test plan: 1) simulate traffic spike -> verify scale up within X minutes, 2) scale down cooldown observed, 3) eviction fallback to shared model variant.

docs-bot: Lint check: docs/lint passed. Link-check: 1 broken anchor found -> replaced as suggested.

Emily Tran: Thanks all — I'll patch in Marc's SDK snippet, change cooldown to 300, and accept Claire's anchor fix. I'll also add Raj's suggested SLA phrasing: we will assert an "SLA-backed latency target for Dedicated; no SLA for shared/reserved burst tiers (best-effort performance)" — wording will be exact sentence for legal review. If no objections I'll merge after CI. :thumbsup:
